incident.title: Password spray → valid-password login → lateral movement → data exfiltration

steps.text: 198.19.76.39 tried 14 real account names (35 attempts) over 4.0 h - a password spray
h.petrov logged in to bastion-01 from 198.19.76.39, the same IP that had just made 35 failed login attempts
h.petrov ran 6 reconnaissance commands on bastion-01 within 43 min: whoami, id, uname -a, cat /etc/passwd, ss -tulpn, ip neigh
bastion-01 probed 57 internal host:port pairs in 19 min (49 refused)
h.petrov ran '/bin/bash' as root on bastion-01 - first time this account used root there (interactive root shell)
h.petrov added an SSH key to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys on bastion-01
h.petrov hopped from bastion-01 to app-01
h.petrov hopped from app-01 to db-01 - first time this account ever reached db-01
h.petrov read 3.48 GB from /var/lib/postgresql/dump on db-01. Also: h.petrov archived data on db-01: 'tar czf /tmp/.sys.tgz /var/lib/postgresql/dump'
db-01 sent 3.58 GB to 198.19.76.39 over 2.5 h in 17 transfers - a destination it had never contacted
